title: The Fixed Rules tab still creates, edits and deletes a fixed rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, with no fixed sell price.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the Fixed Rules tab.
  3. Open the add fixed rule dialog.
  4. Pick part A in the dialog.
  5. Type 40 as the fixed sell price.
  6. Save the dialog.
  7. Open the fixed rule's edit dialog.
  8. Replace the fixed sell price with 45.
  9. Save the dialog.
  10. Delete the fixed rule.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Settings › Pricing opens with Tiers, Matrices and Fixed Rules tabs.

Step 2:

  • The Fixed Rules tab lists the client's fixed rules as production does today.

Step 3:

  • The fixed rule dialog opens as today.

Step 4:

  • Part A is picked.

Step 5:

  • The price reads 40.

Step 6:

  • The fixed rule for part A at $40.00 is listed.

Step 7:

  • The edit dialog opens with $40.00.

Step 8:

  • The price reads 45.

Step 9:

  • The fixed rule reads $45.00.

Step 10:

  • The fixed rule is gone from the list.
  • The tab still lists the other fixed rules.
